_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/e2-instructions-per-turn.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-19.

features.description: Edit a linked agent's instructions between two turns: the second turn's system message contains the new text.
After that second turn, the stored first message is byte-identical to what it was.
The second turn's system message does not contain the superseded instructions.
A session with no agent link is unaffected: its system message is still the stored row's content.
Resume uses the current instructions too.
The per-turn context block and the memory block still appear, after the instructions, in that order.
A linked session whose transcript has no stored system row still gets one carrying the current instructions, and that turn persists no extra row.
The number of stored rows after a turn is unchanged from today's behaviour.
Upstream's existing test suite stays green unmodified, including TestAgentConfirmation.
